name: intrasistema
description: Business productivity and workflow automation tool for Intrasistema. Search, track, and manage omnichannel sales orders (OMS), warehouse inventory (WMS), electronic billing/invoicing (ERP), and customer support tasks directly from chat.

interface.longDescription: Intrasistema boosts business team productivity by connecting your operational workflows directly to ChatGPT and Codex. Quickly search and audit daily sales orders (OMS), check real-time warehouse stock levels (WMS), review electronic invoices and financial balances (ERP), and resolve customer support incidents using structured Markdown tables and two-step human confirmation for any mutating task. Conecta tu cuenta de Intrasistema para gestionar órdenes de venta, depósitos WMS, facturación ERP y reclamos operativos.
defaultPrompt: Generate a daily operational summary of today's sales orders and pending support incidents
Check available warehouse stock and inventory levels for wireless keyboards
Show my active Intrasistema business context and accessible warehouses
